@@ -1,7 +1,13 @@
-from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
 
 
 def allocate_cents(total_cents: int, share: Decimal) -> int:
     if not Decimal(0) <= share <= Decimal(1):
         raise ValueError("share must be between zero and one")
-    return int((Decimal(total_cents) * share).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
+    return int((Decimal(total_cents) * share).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
+
+
+def remaining_cents(total_cents: int, allocated_cents: int) -> int:
+    if allocated_cents > total_cents:
+        raise ValueError("allocation exceeds total")
+    return total_cents - allocated_cents

pull_request.body: Uses decimal inputs for allocation percentages and stores amounts in minor units.
pull_request.title: Calculate allocation percentages from decimal shares

ground_truth.rationale: The documented allocation policy was half-up. A share yielding exactly x.5 cents now rounds to the nearest even cent, so customer invoice lines and reconciled totals differ at tie boundaries.
